sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area/Volume
lecture_lines: The determinant is the signed area of a parallelogram.
Vectors form the sides of this geometric shape.
Area scaling helps us understand linear transformations.
animations: Fade in two basis vectors v1=(2,0) and v2=(0,3).
Draw parallelogram spanned by v1 and v2, filled with color #444444.
Display text 'Area = Det(A) = 6' in color #FFFFFF. Place at grid location D4.

sections.title: Framing the Linear System
lecture_lines: We represent Ax=b as a vector equation.
Scales x and y reach a target point b.
Think of reaching a crumb using two paths.
animations: Show vector A=(1,2) and vector B=(3,1) starting at origin, using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crumb.svg] to mark the origin. Position vectors near grid C3.
Display target point b=(5,5) on the plane at grid D5.
Animate dashed lines showing x*A + y*B = b between C3 and D5.

sections.title: Geometric Substitution
lecture_lines: Replace a column with the target vector b.
New parallelograms emerge from this replacement.
Area ratios reveal the needed scale factors.
The ratio gives x for the first column.
This process defines Cramer's elegant rule.
animations: Display the original parallelogram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] formed by A and B at B2.
Swap column A with vector b to form a new parallelogram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] at D3.
Label the new shape 'Det(Ax) / Det(A)' and position next to it at D4.
Highlight the substitution process with a subtle flash effect.
Finalize the new parallelogram display at D3.

sections.title: Visualization of the Solution
lecture_lines: Visualize the parallelogram area changing dynamically.
The expansion factor directly represents coordinate x.
This visually confirms the determinant ratio identity.
Shrinking areas show lower coordinate values.
Expanding areas show higher coordinate values.
animations: Show the area of the Ax parallelogram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] as it scales in grid area C2-D4.
Overlay the ratio formula: 'x = Det(Ax) / Det(A)' at E2.
Flash the resulting scalar value x to highlight the solution at E3.
Animate the parallelogram contracting as x decreases.
Animate the parallelogram expanding as x increases.

sections.title: Summary and Geometric Intuition
lecture_lines: Cramer's Rule is a geometric ratio of space.
Flat space prevents reaching the target point.
animations: Display a 2D [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] with two collinear vectors forming a flat shape in area A4-C6.
Show the determinant text 'Det(A) = 0' flashing in red at D4.
Show the target b off-line and display 'No Solution' text at D5.
